newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SPRING/WHITE WHEAT - DNS WHEAT HARVEST STARTS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SPRING/WHITE WHEAT - DNS WHEAT HARVEST STARTS.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat harvest was just underway in parts of South Dakota, southern Minnesota and the southern tip of North Dakota and several merchandisers said early cuttings had high protein levels.
"We're getting some new crop in," a Minnesota dealer said. "So far the early stuff is pretty good with high proteins, 15 or 16 percent. But the early stuff is usually high protein."
Merchandisers cautioned that early harvested fields are often the best ones and problems can show up later. One North Dakota dealer said scab damage was already evident and would likely trim yields.
Hot and drier weather in the Pacific Northwest has allowed for rapid progress on the white wheat harvest but dealers there said farmer sales were very light.
"They're not selling it at all," one merchant said. "They're not even asking, not at these prices. If we could get that closer to $4 (per bushel) or over $4 we might see some."
